pages.text: TFMG (The Factory Must Grow) is heavy industry on top of Create. Steel is the gate to most of it. The main route is a $(thing)blast furnace$() fed with hot air, cast into ingots in a basin.

pages.title: Blast Stove
pages.text: Makes Hot Air from air plus fuel. It builds up Carbon Dioxide that stalls it, so pump that out to an Exhaust or Smokestack.

pages.title: Blast Furnace
pages.text: Build a cylinder of Fireproof Bricks around the Output with one Hatch for hot air. Reinforcements speed it up. Items go in at the top.

Inputs: crushed raw iron (or raw iron) plus a flux, which is Limesand. Outputs: molten steel, molten slag and furnace gas. The Blast Stove burns furnace gas or creosote, so the furnace can feed itself.

pages.title: Coke Oven
pages.text: Cooks coal slowly into Coal Coke, creosote and CO2. Build long rows. Coke is a long-burning fuel and the base of graphite electrodes.

pages.title: Casting Basin
pages.text: Molten steel poured in sets into a Steel Ingot (90 mB each). Also casts Big Cannons metals.

A chemical vat with three Graphite Electrodes is a second way to make steel, from crushed raw iron, flux and coke dust, in a large Fireproof Vat. Check JEI for exact sizes. Steel then unlocks pipes, tanks, casings and machines.

Every steel here is the same tag as Alloyed and Create Nuclear steel, so your first steel can come from an easier mod. See $(l:materials/shared_metals)Shared Metals$(/l). Next: $(l:industry/tfmg_oil)TFMG Oil$(/l).
